context: October 26 made positive momentum in all three indices; the buyers it drew were already shaken out by a retracement, and the market is trying to go up again.
plan: FLAT TO GAP UP -> BUY, WITH THE MARKET: the retracement already removed the buyers, so follow the renewed upside and identify buying-side setups; positive momentum from the open is the better case.
SMALL GAP DOWN -> BUY, the same plan, better if the levels do not break: a breakdown near BankNIFTY's round number raises the risk on buyers.
EXPIRY: NIFTY and BankNIFTY both expire on October 27. Treat expiry as context for an already valid setup, not as an entry premise.
